items.description: Each Party must keep the agreement terms and the other Party's non-public information confidential and cause its Representatives to do likewise, during the Term and for a period afterward.
items.span_text: each Party hereby agrees that it will, and will cause its Affiliates and its and their respective directors, officers, employees, professional advisors, agents and other Persons acting on their behalf (including the Client Personnel) (collectively, “Representatives”) to hold, in strict confidence the terms and conditions of this Agreement

items.description: Each Party and its Affiliates must not trade in Mawson's securities while holding material nonpublic information, or until they can do so lawfully and without breaching the agreement.
items.span_text: Each Party agrees that it and its Affiliates will not trade in Mawson’s securities while in possession of material nonpublic information or at all until such Party and such Affiliates can do so in compliance with all applicable laws and without breach of this Agreement.
items.trigger: while in possession of material nonpublic information

items.description: All notices and communications under the agreement must be in writing and delivered by hand, courier, registered or certified mail, or email to the addresses specified.
items.span_text: All notices, requirements, requests, claims, and other communications in relation to this Agreement shall be in writing, and shall be given or made by delivery in person, by an internationally recognized overnight courier service, by registered or certified mail (postage prepaid, return receipt requested) or electronic mail

items.description: Client must not engage in commercial bribery and must ensure its Client Associates do not either.
items.span_text: Client shall not, and shall procure its directors, officers, employees, consultants, agents and other representatives (collectively with Client, the “Client Associates”) not to, directly or indirectly engage in any activity of commercial bribery

items.description: Host may terminate the agreement and other business cooperation with Client and claim damages if a Client Associate breaches the anti-bribery article.
items.span_text: If any of Client Associates commits any act or omission in contravention of Article 17, Host shall be entitled to terminate this Agreement and any other existing business cooperation with Client and claim for damages against Client.
items.trigger: If any of Client Associates commits any act or omission in contravention of Article 17

items.description: Client must promptly provide information and documents Host reasonably requests for know-your-customer and anti-money-laundering compliance.
items.span_text: Promptly following any request therefor, Client shall provide information and documentation reasonably requested by Host for purposes of compliance with applicable “know your customer” requirements and anti-money-laundering rules and regulations

items.description: Neither Party may solicit or induce the other Party's employees or consultants, or use Confidential Information to solicit its customers or suppliers, during the restricted period unless both agree otherwise.
items.span_text: neither Party shall (1) directly or indirectly, solicit, recruit, encourage or induce employees or consultants of the other Party
items.trigger: unless mutually agreed by both Parties
